CLI_BUSY.zh: CLI 正在处理上一条消息，请稍后重试
CLI_BUSY.en: The CLI is still busy; try again shortly

CLI_INTERRUPT_TIMEOUT.zh: 尚未确认任务停止，请稍后重试
CLI_INTERRUPT_TIMEOUT.en: Could not confirm that the turn stopped; try again shortly

CLI_NEEDS_ATTENTION.zh: CLI 需要你先在终端中处理当前操作
CLI_NEEDS_ATTENTION.en: The CLI needs you to handle something in the terminal

DISPATCH_STOPPED.zh: 服务器正在重启，请稍后重试
DISPATCH_STOPPED.en: The server is restarting; try again shortly

DSH_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 当前 DSH 安装缺少官方会话存储读取器
DSH_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE.en: This DSH installation lacks the official session store reader

DSH_PROFILE_BUSY.zh: 此 DSH 配置仍有运行中或等待交互的会话；结束后再应用新的连接设置。
DSH_PROFILE_BUSY.en: Conversations are still running or waiting for input on this DSH profile; apply the new connection settings after they finish.

EXTENSION_RUNTIME_REQUIRED.zh: 先打开使用此 MCP 的会话，再开始授权。
EXTENSION_RUNTIME_REQUIRED.en: Open a conversation that uses this MCP server before authorizing.

INTERACTION_BUSY.zh: 交互请求过多，请稍后重试
INTERACTION_BUSY.en: Too many interaction requests; try again shortly

INTERACTION_REQUEST_REUSED.zh: 此请求已用于另一份答案，请同步后重新提交
INTERACTION_REQUEST_REUSED.en: This request was already used for a different answer; sync and submit again

INVALID_INTERACTION.zh: {reason, select, request {交互请求无效，请刷新后重试} selection {所选选项无效，请重新选择} otherText {其他答案必须是一行且不超过 2000 个字符} other {交互请求无效，请刷新后重试}}
INVALID_INTERACTION.en: {reason, select, request {The interaction request is invalid; refresh and try again} selection {The selected options are invalid; choose again} otherText {The other answer must be one line of at most 2000 characters} other {The interaction request is invalid; refresh and try again}}

INVALID_INTERACTION_ACTION.zh: 当前交互不支持此操作
INVALID_INTERACTION_ACTION.en: The current interaction does not support this action

INVALID_INTERACTION_ANSWER.en: The answer is invalid; choose again

INVALID_NATIVE_MODEL.zh: {reason, select, model {当前原生 CLI 没有模型「{model}」，请重新选择} fast {当前原生 CLI 不支持该模型的 Fast 模式，请关闭 Fast 后重试} context {TRAE CLI 不支持上下文模式「{context}」，请选择 Standard 或 Max} other {所选模型不可用，请重新选择}}
INVALID_NATIVE_MODEL.en: {reason, select, model {The native CLI does not offer the model "{model}"; choose another} fast {The native CLI does not support Fast for this model; turn Fast off and try again} context {The TRAE CLI does not support context mode "{context}"; choose Standard or Max} other {That model is not available; choose another}}

MODEL_CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 暂时无法获取模型列表，请稍后重试
MODEL_CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE.en: The model list is unavailable right now; try again shortly

NATIVE_CONFIG_CHANGED.zh: 会话配置已改变，请重新提交
NATIVE_CONFIG_CHANGED.en: The conversation settings changed; submit again

NATIVE_DELIVERY_UNCERTAIN.zh: 上一条消息的状态尚未确认，请先检查状态
NATIVE_DELIVERY_UNCERTAIN.en: The previous message is still unconfirmed; check its status first

NATIVE_INTERACTION_STALE.zh: CLI 中的问题或选项已经变化，请同步后再操作
NATIVE_INTERACTION_STALE.en: The CLI prompt changed; sync and try again

NATIVE_INTERACTION_UNCONFIRMED.zh: CLI 未确认选项变化，请同步状态
NATIVE_INTERACTION_UNCONFIRMED.en: The CLI did not confirm the selection change; sync the status

NATIVE_INTERRUPT_IN_PROGRESS.zh: 正在停止当前任务，请稍后重试
NATIVE_INTERRUPT_IN_PROGRESS.en: The current turn is stopping; try again shortly

NATIVE_INTERRUPT_SUBMISSION_FAILED.zh: 停止已确认，但后续操作未能完成，请重试
NATIVE_INTERRUPT_SUBMISSION_FAILED.en: The turn stopped, but the follow-up did not complete; try again

NATIVE_QUEUE_CHANGED.zh: 排队消息已改变，请重新确认
NATIVE_QUEUE_CHANGED.en: The queued messages changed; review them again

NATIVE_RECOVERY_BUSY.zh: 正在检查这条消息，请稍后重试
NATIVE_RECOVERY_BUSY.en: This message is being checked; try again shortly

NATIVE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED.zh: 请更新客户端后检查消息状态
NATIVE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED.en: Update the app to check this message before continuing

NATIVE_RECOVERY_UNSAFE.zh: 暂时无法继续发送，请先检查消息状态
NATIVE_RECOVERY_UNSAFE.en: Sending cannot safely continue yet; check the message status

NATIVE_RUN_NOT_QUEUED.zh: 这条消息已离开队列，请刷新后重试
NATIVE_RUN_NOT_QUEUED.en: This message is no longer queued; refresh and try again

NATIVE_SESSION_BUSY.zh: 这个会话正在启动中，请稍候
NATIVE_SESSION_BUSY.en: This conversation is starting; try again shortly

NATIVE_STOP_CONFLICT.zh: 停止请求与原任务不一致，请刷新状态
NATIVE_STOP_CONFLICT.en: This stop request does not match the original task; refresh its status

NATIVE_STOP_TARGET_REQUIRED.zh: 请更新客户端后停止任务
NATIVE_STOP_TARGET_REQUIRED.en: Update the app to stop this task safely

NATIVE_STOP_UNCONFIRMED.zh: 暂时无法确认任务是否已停止，请检查状态
NATIVE_STOP_UNCONFIRMED.en: The stop has not been confirmed; check the task status

RUNTIME_CONTROL_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 暂时无法执行，请稍后重试
RUNTIME_CONTROL_UNAVAILABLE.en: This can't run right now; try again shortly

RUN_ALREADY_DISPATCHED.zh: 消息可能已经执行，请使用停止操作
RUN_ALREADY_DISPATCHED.en: The message may already be running; use Stop instead

SHARE_HISTORY_CHANGED.zh: 会话历史已变化，请重新生成预览
SHARE_HISTORY_CHANGED.en: The conversation history changed; generate the preview again

SHARE_HISTORY_NOT_FOUND.en: The conversation history file does not exist

SHARE_HISTORY_SCOPE_MISMATCH.zh: 会话历史不属于当前会话
SHARE_HISTORY_SCOPE_MISMATCH.en: The conversation history belongs to another conversation

SHARE_HISTORY_TOO_LARGE.zh: 会话历史过大，请缩小分享范围
SHARE_HISTORY_TOO_LARGE.en: The conversation history is too large; share less

SHARE_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE.zh: 无法读取会话历史，请稍后重试
SHARE_HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE.en: The conversation history could not be read; try again shortly

SHARE_SELECTION_INVALID.zh: {reason, select, count {分享的轮数无效，请重新选择} changed {所选消息已变化，请重新选择} session {所选消息不属于当前会话} other {所选消息无效，请重新选择}}
SHARE_SELECTION_INVALID.en: {reason, select, count {The number of shared turns is invalid} changed {The selected messages changed; select them again} session {The selected messages do not belong to this conversation} other {The selected messages are invalid; select them again}}

STEER_ACTION_UNSUPPORTED.zh: 此操作不适用于补充消息
STEER_ACTION_UNSUPPORTED.en: This action does not apply to a follow-up message

STEER_CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED.zh: 补充消息沿用当前任务的配置
STEER_CONFIG_UNSUPPORTED.en: A follow-up message uses the current task settings

STEER_REJECTED.zh: 补充消息未能发送，请检查内容后重试
STEER_REJECTED.en: The follow-up message was not sent; check it and try again

STEER_UNSUPPORTED.zh: 当前 Agent 不支持补充消息
STEER_UNSUPPORTED.en: This agent does not support follow-up messages during a task

UNSUPPORTED_OTHER_DESELECT.zh: 当前 CLI 无法取消已经选中的多选 Other；请保留或修改其他答案，或跳过整组问题
UNSUPPORTED_OTHER_DESELECT.en: The CLI cannot deselect a selected Other option; keep or change it, or skip the question
